compiled_state.title: PR creation and auto-merge queue with state persistence
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- DD1 (partial): merge-to-main-pr.sh creates a PR via gh pr create and queues gh pr merge --auto
- DD6 (full PR side): script emits CONFLICT_DATA on conflict (mergeable=CONFLICTING)

## Description
Implement the merge phase of merge-to-main-pr.sh. Behaviors:
1. `git push -u origin "$BRANCH"` to publish the branch
2. `gh pr create --base main --head "$BRANCH" --title "<derived from last meaningful commit>" --body "<auto>"`
3. Capture PR URL and PR number; record `pr_url` and `pr_number` into the state file (extend `merge-helpers.sh` state writer or add a new state writer in pr.sh)
4. Queue auto-merge: `gh pr merge "$PR_NUMBER" --auto --merge` (use `--merge` not `--squash` to match direct's `--no-ff` semantics — confirmed in discovery)
5. On `gh pr create` reporting CONFLICTING (mergeable status), call `_emit_conflict_data "$BRANCH" "main" "pr-auto-merge"` and exit 1
6. On `gh pr merge` rejection due to "auto-merge not allowed" (repo setting), print a clear error indicating the GitHub setting and exit 1

Write a NEW test file `tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-pr.sh` using the `gh` PATH-shim pattern from `test-merge-to-main-dispatcher.sh`. Tests (RED first):

Given/When/Then for each:
- **t_pr_create_invocation**: Given a clean branch with seeded commits; When pr.sh runs; Then `gh` is invoked with `pr create --base main --head <branch>` (assert via shim argv log)
- **t_pr_auto_merge_queued**: Given pr create succeeds with PR #42; When pr.sh proceeds; Then `gh` is invoked with `pr merge 42 --auto --merge` (assert via shim argv log)
- **t_pr_state_file_persists_pr_url**: Given pr create returns URL; When pr.sh exits the merge phase; Then state file contains `pr_url` and `pr_number` keys
- **t_pr_conflict_emits_conflict_data**: Given gh reports mergeable=CONFLICTING; When pr.sh runs the merge phase; Then stdout contains `CONFLICT_DATA` with schema keys and exit ≠ 0

Add `.test-index` mapping for `merge-to-main-pr.sh` → `tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-pr.sh` if fuzzy-match would not find it.

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh (modify — implement merge phase)
- tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-pr.sh (create, chmod +x)
- .test-index (verify mapping exists or add)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] All 4 new tests pass
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-pr.sh
- [ ] New test file is executable
  Verify: test -x tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-pr.sh
- [ ] RED markers added to .test-index for any tests that fail before impl (none expected once impl is complete)
  Verify: ! grep -E '^\\[t_pr_' .test-index || true

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context.
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user.
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation: skip opus, escalate to user immediately.
